category: Setting up a ledger in a project

history.name: Generated documents stay out of version control
history.description: Setup adds the output directory to the project's `.gitignore`, so the documents and the PDF are treated as build output and the record itself is the thing that gets committed. Version history then belongs to the ledger rather than to files regenerated on every build.
history.dev_notes: addGitignore() in src/commands/init.mjs, appending config.output.dir; skipped with --no-gitignore, and a no-op if the line is already there.
